rules.checkpoint_id: ASCII [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,95}; the selected checkpoint is never substituted across variants
rules.claims_qualified: must be false; a manifest cannot qualify the candidate
rules.file_checks: absolute regular files; every declared SHA-256 must match the actual bytes; weights byte count must match
rules.framewise_causal: requires zero lookahead and zero offline context
rules.framewise_lookahead: requires positive lookahead and zero offline context
rules.offline_chunked: requires positive offline context, zero lookahead and zero left-context declaration
rules.oracle_variant: probability and event oracles must declare the same model_variant as the manifest

verification: manifest is strict JSON with exactly the required fields
source revision is a full 40-hex commit and license is recorded
the selected variant and checkpoint ID are declared exactly
weights, runtime lock, probability oracle, event oracle, rights and corpus records are absolute present files with matching digests
weights byte count matches the declared value
geometry is 16 kHz mono 160-sample SDK frames with a bounded window, hop, context and lookahead
framewise, lookahead and offline declarations are mutually exclusive
probability values are finite and inside [0,1]; events are ordered half-open intervals
oracles from a different MarbleNet variant are rejected
rights and corpus records do not claim qualification
no download, copy, import, model load or execution occurs here
schema acceptance never qualifies the candidate
